findings.issue: The desktop queue checked busy before reducing turn_end, then never retried.
findings.fix: SessionRegistry notifies settlement after reduction. Spoken messages queue FIFO per originating chat; acknowledged queued text clears the composer.

findings.issue: A decode error ended the whole microphone session; outstanding uploads were not cancelled.
findings.fix: Bound and cancel upload/decode HTTP operations, release endpoint gates in finally, retain an armed session after errors, and reject old-session completions.

findings.issue: The web composer preferred the provisional span over final ASR, and could start another take during final decoding.
findings.fix: Use final ASR text, serialize the recording/finalization lifecycle, re-arm VAD after completion, and bind every upload/decode to its original session signal.

findings.issue: The old Windows recorder amplitude loop indexed PCM samples using the byte count, reading beyond the sample buffer.
findings.fix: Upgrade record 5.2.1 / record_windows 1.0.7 to record 7.1.2 / record_windows 2.3.0, which uses a bounded sample loop and includes stream/disposal fixes. Remove the obsolete record_linux override.

findings.issue: The decoder initialized on first speech and expired after two idle minutes.
findings.fix: Background startup warmup loads and exercises the installed local decoder without microphone access or downloads. A startup-warmed worker is retained until shutdown or an explicit resource transition.

findings.issue: The sidecar acknowledged send_message before checking busy or persona admission, so rejected speech appeared accepted.
findings.fix: Reject busy/setup-gated sends before acknowledgement. A real-dispatcher regression failed before the fix and passes after, including concurrent admission.

validation.desktop: 86 full-suite tests passed, followed by 5 targeted recovery tests including the added composer widget regression.
validation.browser: DOM-mounted useDictation regression passes repeated pause-send, transient decode failure, finalization backpressure, and session restart during upload.
validation.core: Warmup/routing/worker/queue regressions pass. Initial broad core run: 573 passed, one existing session_event_log timing failure during concurrent native compilation; that unchanged six-test file passes separately.
validation.python: Four speech-gate/warmup tests passed without downloading ASR weights.
validation.build: Full TypeScript build, workspace typecheck, browser production build and repository secret verification passed. Required PR checks and packaged builds must pass before publication.
validation.hardware: RTX 3080 Windows CUDA: explicit background warmup 12884 ms; subsequent 4-second English decodes 212, 190 and 180 ms. These measurements exclude microphone endpoint silence thresholds.
validation.limits: Physical microphone and speaker acoustics require user confirmation. Local speech synthesis, model switching, cancellation or a decoder crash may release the warm ASR worker and require loading again. No claim of zero latency immediately after launching is made.
